May.reason: Killen Creek road access is often still snow-gated and the approach carries deep, unstable spring snowpack

July.reason: First half of the month remains solid; rockfall from the warming ridge crest increases later in July

June.reason: Firm snow with minimized rockfall and crevasse hazard

August.reason: Outside the June-to-mid-July window; expect increased rockfall and more open crevasses on the glaciers beside the ridge

May.reason: Within the best-season window; firm alpine ice/snow on the headwall

July.reason: Outside the best-season window; expect an unstable, warmed-out headwall

June.reason: Still within the season window, but rockfall increases as the headwall warms

April.reason: Still full winter/early-spring conditions with deep, unconsolidated snow and difficult access

seasonal_guidance.optimalWindow: Jul-Oct; core dry-talus conditions are most reliable August-September

July.reason: Early-season snow patches can still linger on the east slopes and old ski runs; talus and heather may be partly snow-covered

August.reason: Slopes typically fully melted out to open heather and talus; most reliable dry scrambling conditions

October.reason: Early snow can return to the upper slopes and ski area boundary zones, adding route-finding and traction difficulty

September.reason: Stable, dry conditions continue; cooler temps and fewer bugs make this a favored month

seasonal_guidance.optimalWindow: Late June (once Royal Basin permits open, before rock fully dries out)

May.reason: Approach often still snow-covered; a documented serious accident occurred this month (May 2026 rescue)

July.reason: Rock reportedly becomes nightmarishly loose as snow melts out of the gullies; rockfall risk rises through the month

June.reason: Climbing before July 1 is recommended while gullies remain snow-covered, holding the loose pillow-lava rock in place; Royal Basin permits open June 15

August.reason: Gullies fully melted to scree/choss; reportedly the least favorable month of the summer

September.reason: Rock remains dry/loose like August, but cooler temps and lower party traffic reduce triggered-rockfall exposure

seasonal_guidance.optimalWindow: June through August; August is the most reliable window

July.reason: In season; early in the month snow can linger and rivers may still run high

June.reason: Trail network and approach terrain still largely snowbound at elevation; river fords are dangerous with peak snowmelt, so treat a high river as a reason to turn back

August.reason: Most stable weather and driest approach/scramble conditions of the year

October.reason: Falls outside the season; full winter conditions can arrive on this long, remote approach

September.reason: Just past the usual season; cooler and generally stable, but early-season snow becomes a real possibility by late month

seasonal_guidance.optimalWindow: Late July — solid snow cover for a manageable glacier crossing

July.reason: A documented late-July ascent found solid snow cover and a manageable glacier crossing

August.reason: A late-August NPS ranger visit found bare ice, open crevasses, and a summit-blocking moat (~5 ft wide) that turned the party back
